name: Demon Fall Ridge
summary: In southeastern Ashenvale, demons hold the high ground above the place where Mannoroth fell. Lingering fel magic stains the ridge, and the Burning Legion has claimed a night elf barrow den.

sections.title: A Perch Over Corruption
sections.body: Demon Fall Ridge rises west of Demon Fall Canyon, its cliffs stained by fel left from the Third War. Below, the canyon marks the clash between Grommash Hellscream and the pit lord Mannoroth. Surviving demons use the ridge as a staging ground. Lesser demons patrol the rocky heights, defiling the woodland and threatening travelers along Ashenvale's southern border.

sections.title: The Desecrated Barrow
sections.body: A night elf barrow den lies abandoned in the ridge's side, its passages turned into a stronghold of dark sorcery. Fel fiends fill the halls where druids once slept. In the deepest reaches, Diathorus the Seeker, a cunning dreadlord, rules the conclave and directs the remaining demons across the forest.

faq.answer: Demon Fall Ridge rises in southeastern Ashenvale, west of Demon Fall Canyon and near the Barrens border.

faq.q: Why are there demons on this ridge?
faq.answer: The ridge overlooks the place where Mannoroth died in the Third War. Demons who survived the Legion's defeat scattered into the heights and entrenched themselves on the ridge and in an abandoned barrow den.
Diathorus the Seeker, a powerful nathrezim dreadlord, commands the conclave from the deepest reaches of the barrow den.

faq.q: What is the structure carved into the ridge?
faq.answer: The structure is an ancient night elf barrow den, once a druid sanctuary for entering the Emerald Dream. It was abandoned and overrun and desecrated by the Burning Legion.

angles.text: As a druid, you see demons occupying a barrow den once sacred to the Emerald Dream, an affront to the Cenarion Circle.
As a warlock, you find an active dreadlord leading the fel forces, a glimpse of organized Legion remnants in Kalimdor.
